`runSmoke({ targets, fetchImpl })` has no conflict with `contract.test.mjs:124-353`. The targets are frontends/backend/senatran/sefaz/pec/ch. The report has `complete`, `pec.state`, and `rows[]{target,result,reason,status,adapterMessage}`. `runSmoke` runs no SQL and does not start or stop processes. It writes the table and JSON to `DETRAN_STACK_STATE_DIR`. The prompt forbids the literal `Bearer` and the words token/password/secret in evidence and uses `local-principal`, which satisfies `:239`. The fixture matchers are consistent. Offline, `persona`/`fixture` are row metadata and IDs are compared only through an explicit matcher, which is compatible with `items:[{id:'fixture-001'}]`. The CLI table supplies the real C-02-05 matchers (RAIT-FRESH-2026-000001, N1 alert, etc.).

The five default roles stay in the literal form `DETRAN_LOCAL_ROLES:-…` at `detran-stack.sh:417`. Personas are overridden only through env on a restart of a backend found running, and the default is restored at the end.

The CH fixture is idempotent, under `tools/stack/`, with deterministic test IDs. It runs only after `validate_database_name` (`detran-stack.sh:85-87`, called at `:120,269,283`), with a refusal transcript. It does not touch `backend/database/seed/**` and stays outside RAIT/PEC R-0031. SQL fixtures do not relax policy or RLS. Council is exempted if it reaches the adapter first.

The offline proof (`pnpm test:stack`, `pnpm check` = acceptance_commands) is separate from checkpoint (b) and `ci:backend-kernel:local`. This is consistent with plan.md 'Gates TASK-0006/0007' and CTG-0002 §C-02-06.
